More about Red Hotel Cubao, Quezon City

Red Hotel Cubao, Quezon City

Set in Manila, 400 metres from Smart Araneta Coliseum, Red Hotel Cubao, Quezon City offers accommodation with a fitness centre, free private parking, a restaurant and a bar.

Comment: 12 Feb 2026

5.0/5
I had a pleasant stay at Red Hotel Cubao. The location is very convenient—close to Araneta City, malls, restaurants, and public transportation, which makes it ideal for both short stays and quick city trips.
The room was modern, clean, and comfortable. I appreciated the minimalist design and the cozy bed after a long day out. The bathroom was well-maintained, and water pressure was good. WiFi was stable during my stay.
